prompt: Finish the single-file Java NSX Policy client in src/NsxPolicyClient.java. The client must PATCH a Group using the VCF 9.1 Policy API contract in docs/contract.json, then survive a 401 on the following ReadGroupForDomain request by refreshing once and retrying only that failed request. Preserve the completed PATCH, send the exact contract paths and headers, and omit every unset optional Group or Condition field instead of serializing empty strings, arrays, or nulls. Use only the Java 17 standard library; do not add dependencies or edit the protected contract (docs/contract.json, docs/official_sources.json) or the test harness (test/ContractMockServer.java, test/TestMain.java, verify.sh). Run ./verify.sh.
